species.name: Lake trout
why: Water 51°F on top, right in their comfort range.
Best water today is 16–62 ft deep, mostly on open water over the deep basin.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 60 ft, cold below.

species.name: Yellow perch
why: Water 51°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 8–38 ft deep, mostly on open water over the deep basin.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 60 ft, cold below.

species.name: Smallmouth bass
why: Water 51°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 6–32 ft deep, mostly on wind-blown banks.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 60 ft, cold below.
West wind at 8 mph pushes bait onto the east shore: try the wind-blown banks.
